SITE INFORMATION

Terms of use

This dashboard is a project presentation and analytical demonstration. Its displayed scorecard values are supplied project data and have not been independently validated by this website.

Use of the site

You may use the dashboard to explore its stated methodology and supplied cricket statistics for personal, educational, and evaluation purposes. You are responsible for checking source data and methods before relying on any result.

Information and limitations

Player scores, counts, and summaries are presented for this case study. They are not official rankings, predictions, medical assessments, or selection recommendations. “Heartbeat” is a metaphor for pressure response; the dashboard does not measure a player’s heart rate or mental state.

Intellectual property and attribution

Player names, competition names, and third-party marks belong to their respective owners. Their appearance does not imply sponsorship or endorsement. Cite the underlying data sources when reusing their material.

Availability and changes

The site is provided as-is for demonstration. Features, data, and availability may change as the project is updated.

Contact
